lua: T = require('lib.testkit'); S = require('lib.state'); CAM = require('lib.camera'); W = require('lib.world'); FOLLOW = nil; LOOK = function(lx, ly, lz, ty, fov, tx, tz) local v = nova.named('van'); local s, c = math.sin(v.heading), math.cos(v.heading); local g = W.height(v.x, v.z); local ax, _, az = v:to_world(tx or 0, 0, tz or 0); CAM.pinned = { v.x + s * lz + c * lx, g + ly, v.z + c * lz - s * lx, ax, g + (ty or 0.85), az, fov or 30 } end; PARK = function(x, z, h) local v = nova.named('van'); v.autopilot = nil; v.driven = false; v.engine_on = false; v:teleport(x, z, h); nova.scene_now().mode = 'foot'; local p = nova.named('postmaster'); p.seated = false; p.control = true end; BESIDE = function(lx, lz, turn) local s = nova.scene_now(); local p = nova.named('postmaster'); p.x, p.z = s:van_point({ lx, 0, lz }); p.face = nova.named('van').heading + (turn or 0); p.walk_to, p.walk_path = nil, nil end; AT = function(x, z, face) local p = nova.named('postmaster'); p.x, p.z, p.face = x, z, face; p.walk_to, p.walk_path = nil, nil; CAM.pinned = nil; CAM.reset(face) end
